primary_data: Hash-verified author Table1 processed caches with original prompt, fixed target, sink/thinking spans, token eligibility and original metrics. No locally regenerated replacement cohort.
official_sampling: The author Table1 release explicitly identifies the actual generator and judge, and faithfulness K=1 versus recovery K=3. Use its processed caches without new generator/judge calls. Supplementary data must follow the author original process and be distinguished from released table reproduction.
paper_result_reuse: Use identical author cached targets and protocol for comparison. Published aggregate values are comparable only with matching model/configuration, task cohort and aggregation; old8-case development means are not full-table reproduction.
historical_exposure: NIq2 all100 and MoreHopQA all95 have prior-use evidence. Reuse is allowed for development/reproduction; never relabel those rows as pristine independent confirmation.
local_generation_branch: Stopped by explicit user scope; saved44 outputs excluded from all official method comparisons. No attribution or quality score was computed on them.
resource_priority: Use existing evidence to choose edits; no default exhaustive reruns, parameter grids or dataset expansion to seek significance.
next_change: FA first: native input strides are validated but not promoted because B4 measured slower and full peak did not fall. Keep SharedMeanReuse as the current preferred path. Review repeated finite passes and the extra public LSE invocation for supported reuse before another GPU screen; output casts can only extend existing public compiler boundaries. No shadow attention/model/backward, MLP/head work, broad parameter or quality sweep.

initial_optimization_screen.reason: Existing development cases only: longer NI input and largest observed P1/FTseq cost ratio. Diagnostic selection, not representative quality confirmation.
initial_optimization_screen.stop_if: Stop on invalid finite math/provenance, unintended quadratic buffers, or actual inability to run the intended workload. Memory above FA is evaluated jointly with measured speed, throughput and capacity, not rejected by a fixed byte line. Small noisy timing changes are inconclusive.
initial_optimization_screen.optional_followup: Only after a promising initial screen, at most6 same-scope seq-only originalFT attributions and2 actual ordinary input-backward memory references under a frozen protocol. Independent confirmation and larger B4 evaluation are separate stages, never automatically launched.
initial_optimization_screen.quality_policy: Compare full new signed/projected vectors to pinned original parent. Exact vector/source/input matches permit traceable old-curve reuse; changed vectors cannot inherit old metrics. Do not evaluate more curves until the implementation passes the screen and a bounded followup is recorded.

completion: Development quality advantage established; independent quality, conditional direction and full efficiency goals remain unproved.

memory_policy.reference: Actual default-FA execution on the same model, device, dtype, sequence lengths and actual batch; report forward and same-target frozen-parameter input backward separately.
memory_policy.decision: Allow memory above FA reference when justified by measured latency/throughput gains; evaluate peak memory, maximum runnable length/batch and scaling together. No new fixed absolute or ratio rejection line.
memory_policy.retained_requirement: Avoid global quadratic attention attribution buffers and preserve genuine model/FA implementations.
memory_policy.historical_records: Old frozen memory gates remain historical execution facts, not current eligibility rules. Full-layer MLP reuse is an eligible unmeasured-speed candidate.

optimization_priority: FA finite extension integration and avoidable FA-side work
bounded real whole-network/batch checks for each FA change
non-attention MLP/head optimizations after FA work

remaining_FA_work: three-pass dependency and redundant tile reads

FA_shared_endpoint_mean.not_complete: No independent quality/sign confirmation, updated FT comparison or new long-input validation.
